settings.compilationInProgress: Documents are being processed. Wait for completion or cancel the tasks before changing models.
settings.migrationRequired: Published documents require a model migration. Change models through the reindex workflow.
settings.revisionConflict: Settings have changed. Reload the latest settings and select again. Reloading discards unsaved model and retrieval changes.
taskFailure.access: You do not have access to the required resource. Ask an administrator to check permissions.
taskFailure.attemptsExhausted: Processing was retried several times and still did not finish. Retry it; if it keeps failing, contact an administrator with the reference below.
taskFailure.configuration: This task needs configuration changes before it can continue. Review the related settings or ask an administrator.
taskFailure.conflict: The content changed while this task was running. Review the latest state and try again.
taskFailure.documentProcessing: Document processing failed before a usable revision was created. Retry the task; if it still fails, contact an administrator.
taskFailure.embeddingDimension: The embedding model's vector size no longer matches this Agent Knowledge Base's index. Restore the previous embedding model, or rebuild the index for the new one.
taskFailure.internal: An internal Agent Knowledge Base error stopped this task. Retry it; if it still fails, contact an administrator.
taskFailure.invalid: The task input could not be processed. Review the file or settings and try again.
taskFailure.leaseLost: Processing was interrupted and will start again automatically.
taskFailure.modelConfiguration: A selected Agent Knowledge Base model is missing, invalid, or incompatible. Check the model settings before retrying.
taskFailure.modelContextLimit: The model context cannot fit this document element and the processing instructions. Check the model's context limit before retrying.
taskFailure.modelFailed: The selected model rejected the request. Check the model settings and remaining quota, then retry.
taskFailure.modelOutputLimit: The model output reached its token limit after automatic budget adjustment and window splitting. Contact an administrator to check the output limit.
taskFailure.modelResponseInvalid: The selected model returned a response that could not be used, usually because it does not support structured output or truncated it. Switch to another model or retry later.
taskFailure.modelService: A selected model service failed or did not respond while processing the document. Check the model service, then try again.
taskFailure.modelTimeout: The selected model did not respond in time. It will be retried automatically; if it keeps timing out, switch to a faster model.
taskFailure.modelUnavailable: The selected model service could not be reached. Check that the model service is running, then retry.
taskFailure.parser: The parser could not read or process this document. Check the file and parser settings, then try again.
taskFailure.parserInputInvalid: The parser could not read this file. It may be corrupted, encrypted, or empty. Check the file and upload it again.
taskFailure.parserNotConfigured: No document parser is configured for this Agent Knowledge Base. Configure a parser in the settings, then retry.
taskFailure.parserRateLimited: The document parser is busy. It will be retried automatically; retry manually if it still fails later.
taskFailure.parserResponseInvalid: The document parser returned an unusable result. Retry; if it keeps failing, contact an administrator.
taskFailure.parserTimeout: Parsing timed out, usually because the file is very large or complex. Retry later, or split the file before uploading.
taskFailure.parserUnavailable: The document parser service is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.
taskFailure.parserUnsupportedType: This file format is not supported by the configured parser. Convert it to a supported format and upload it again.
taskFailure.pdfRender: The PDF pages could not be rendered to extract images. Make sure the file is not damaged or password-protected, then retry.
taskFailure.research: The research retrieval task could not finish. Retry it; if it still fails, contact an administrator.
taskFailure.source: The data source could not be read or synchronized. Check its connection and configuration, then try again.
taskFailure.sourceConfigInvalid: The data source configuration is incomplete or invalid. Review the source settings.
taskFailure.sourceConnection: The data source connection is missing or no longer usable. Reconnect the data source.
taskFailure.sourceContentMissing: The data source returned a document without content. Check the document at the source, then retry.
taskFailure.sourceContentTooLarge: A document from the data source exceeds the size limit. Split or exclude it at the source.
taskFailure.sourceCrawlPageNotFound: A selected web page no longer exists or cannot be reached. Preview the website again and update the selection.
taskFailure.sourceCrawlProviderUnavailab: The website crawl service did not respond. Retry later.
taskFailure.sourceCrawlResultLimit: The crawl found more pages than the configured limit. Narrow the crawl scope or raise the limit.
taskFailure.sourceCredential: The data source credentials are invalid or have expired. Reauthorize the data source or update its credentials.
taskFailure.sourceDocumentCompilation: A document from the data source failed while being processed. Open the document to see the exact error.
taskFailure.sourcePartial: Some documents could not be imported from the data source. Check the failed items in the document list, then retry.
taskFailure.sourceProviderRejected: The data source provider rejected the request or returned unusable data. Check the source configuration and permissions.
taskFailure.sourceProviderTimeout: The data source provider did not respond in time. Retry later.
taskFailure.sourceProviderUnavailable: The data source provider could not be reached. Check the network and the provider status, then retry.
taskFailure.sourceWorkflowTimeout: Waiting for the data source timed out. Retry later.
taskFailure.storageTemporary: File storage or another required service is temporarily unavailable. It will be retried automatically.
taskFailure.temporary: A required service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
taskFailure.upload: The file upload could not be completed or verified. Upload the file again.
